description_en: Releases the internal endpoint of a shard or Configserver node for a sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 释放分片集群实例的Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的内网连接地址
name: ReleaseNodePrivateNetworkAddress

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sharded cluster instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shard or Configserver node.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html API to query the ID of the shard or Configserver node.

<notice>

When you release an SRV address, enter the instance ID for this parameter.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html接口查询Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的ID。
<notice>当释放srv地址时，此处填写实例ID即可。></notice>
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the internal endpoint for the node. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud.

Classic: classic network.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62135.html API to query the network type of the internal endpoint for the node
parameters.help_zh:
该节点内网连接地址所属的网络类型，取值：
VPC：专有网络。
Classic：经典网络。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62135.html接口查询该节点的内网连接地址所属的网络类型
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the public endpoint. Valid values:

SRV

Normal

This parameter is available only when the endpoint to be released is an SRV endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
公网地址类型，可选值：
SRV
Normal
当释放的连接地址是SRV地址时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: connection_type
